sentences.en: This cuisine is seasoned to evoke the esprit of Paris.
sentences.zh: 这种烹饪风格让人联想到巴黎的精神。

sentences.en: Nothing in Chinese cuisine has impressed me like Pu-Erh tea.
sentences.zh: 中国菜中让我印象最深刻的就是普洱茶。

sentences.en: The deep-fried butter stick is the crowning glory of American cuisine.
sentences.zh: 油炸黄油棒是美国菜肴的点睛之笔。

senses.zh: 厨房烹调法, 烹饪, 烹调风格。
